limitations: Structural drift only, not behavioural equivalence. A function here is one FDE extent: split hot/cold parts are separate rows and code without unwind data is absent. objdump is a linear sweep, so data inside .text can mis-decode. moved_only means equal after masking only address-like operands (branch targets outside the extent, RIP-relative displacements, immediates inside the mapped image); data those addresses point to is not compared, so a changed .rodata constant reached through RIP can still be moved_only. changed pairs are inferred from call-graph position plus a size bound, not proven to be the same source function. equivalent_unpaired rows have a masked twin on the other side but no unique pairing. Unmatched rows are not proven additions or removals. Path rows describe embedded strings only, not code ownership.
